name: case-tech
description: Entorno local de Case-Tech con WordPress Playground (sin Docker).

scripts.dev: npx -y @wp-playground/cli@latest server --login --blueprint=playground/blueprint.json --mount-dir ./wordpress/wp-content/themes/case-tech /wordpress/wp-content/themes/case-tech --mount-dir ./wordpress/wp-content/plugins/case-tech-custom /wordpress/wp-content/plugins/case-tech-custom --define-bool WP_DEBUG true --define-bool WP_DEBUG_LOG true --define-bool WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY false
